_about: Shared app/server registries (SEED_AND_IMPORT §15). Built from contract/registries.template.json and the Flutter prototype; seed data and validation read only this file. Phase 4 adds league tiers, achievements and unit art.

avatars._source: Prototype TravelerAvatar (lib/widgets/brand.dart) is parameterized by hue; keys map to the prototype's sample-traveller hues (lib/data/community.dart), the learner's own hue (0.12) and the coach's (0.58). The app renders an unknown key with the default.

guest_names._about: POST /auth/guest display names: a curated word plus a number (backend §5), in the default language (ar).

goal_anchors._about: Onboarding curiosity choices (User.goal_anchor), from the contract registry template. Bridges are reviewed onboarding copy bundled in the app; the server only validates keys and never uses them for ordering, recommendations, adaptation or inference.
